description: This file demonstrates integration of Facebook SDK in a PHP web page, handling user authentication via Facebook OAuth, displaying user profile info if logged in, or a Facebook login button otherwise. It also includes JavaScript for initializing the Facebook SDK and handling login/logout events.

classes.name: Facebook
classes.description: A class representing Facebook SDK integration, providing methods to initialize SDK, authenticate users, and retrieve user data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for Facebook class, initializes the SDK with app ID and secret.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's Facebook ID if logged in.

methods.name: api
methods.description: Calls Facebook Graph API endpoints, e.g., '/me' to get user profile.
